dataset_validation_metadata_check.name: dataset_validation_metadata_check
dataset_validation_metadata_check.value:
"market_entry"."dataset_versions"."publication_status" not in ('validated', 'published') or (
    nullif(btrim("market_entry"."dataset_versions"."owner_name"), '') is not null and "market_entry"."dataset_versions"."data_as_of" is not null
    and "market_entry"."dataset_versions"."reviewed_at" is not null and "market_entry"."dataset_versions"."review_due_at" is not null
    and ("market_entry"."dataset_versions"."checksum" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') is true
  )

geo_boundaries_geometry_check.name: geo_boundaries_geometry_check
geo_boundaries_geometry_check.value:
ST_SRID("market_entry"."geo_boundaries"."geom") = 4326 AND ST_NDims("market_entry"."geo_boundaries"."geom") = 2
    AND ST_GeometryType("market_entry"."geo_boundaries"."geom") IN ('ST_Polygon', 'ST_MultiPolygon')
    AND NOT ST_IsEmpty("market_entry"."geo_boundaries"."geom") AND ST_IsValid("market_entry"."geo_boundaries"."geom")

generated.as: CASE level WHEN 'province' THEN 'country' WHEN 'commune' THEN 'province' END

geo_units_coordinates_check.name: geo_units_coordinates_check
geo_units_coordinates_check.value: ("market_entry"."geo_units"."latitude" IS NULL AND "market_entry"."geo_units"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("market_entry"."geo_units"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "market_entry"."geo_units"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

infrastructure_pois_point_check.name: infrastructure_pois_point_check
infrastructure_pois_point_check.value:
CASE WHEN ST_SRID("market_entry"."infrastructure_pois"."geom") = 4326
    AND ST_NDims("market_entry"."infrastructure_pois"."geom") = 2 AND ST_GeometryType("market_entry"."infrastructure_pois"."geom") = 'ST_Point' AND NOT ST_IsEmpty("market_entry"."infrastructure_pois"."geom")
    THEN ST_X("market_entry"."infrastructure_pois"."geom") BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND ST_Y("market_entry"."infrastructure_pois"."geom") BETWEEN -90 AND 90 ELSE false END

observations_value_check.name: observations_value_check
observations_value_check.value:
CASE
    WHEN "market_entry"."observations"."quality_status" = 'unavailable' THEN "market_entry"."observations"."value_numeric" IS NULL AND "market_entry"."observations"."value_text" IS NULL AND "market_entry"."observations"."missing_reason" IS NOT NULL
    WHEN "market_entry"."observations"."value_type" IN ('text', 'category') THEN "market_entry"."observations"."value_numeric" IS NULL AND "market_entry"."observations"."value_text" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("market_entry"."observations"."value_text") <> '' AND "market_entry"."observations"."missing_reason" IS NULL
    ELSE "market_entry"."observations"."value_numeric" IS NOT NULL AND "market_entry"."observations"."value_text" IS NULL AND "market_entry"."observations"."missing_reason" IS NULL
      AND "market_entry"."observations"."value_numeric" > '-Infinity'::numeric AND "market_entry"."observations"."value_numeric" < 'Infinity'::numeric
      AND ("market_entry"."observations"."value_type" <> 'integer' OR "market_entry"."observations"."value_numeric" = trunc("market_entry"."observations"."value_numeric"))
      AND ("market_entry"."observations"."value_type" <> 'percent' OR "market_entry"."observations"."value_numeric" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
    END
